name: hesitate_reach
text: A shopper stands at a counter, reaches the right hand toward an item, stops just short of taking it, then pulls the hand back toward the chest uncertainly. One clear aborted reach; left arm relaxed.

review.reason: 左臂伸向前方，中途犹豫后收回；转头看向侧面。原提示指定右臂，实际为左臂，已如实记录。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
